rows.ARS:
Deep pink Miniature.
Registration name: Buttons 'n' Bows
rows.Origin:
Bred by L. Pernille Olesen (Denmark, 1981). Bred by Mogens Nyegaard Olesen (Denmark, 1981).
Introduced in Denmark by Poulsen Roser A/S as 'Buttons 'n' Bows'.
rows.Bloom: Deep pink. Fruity fragrance. 28 petals. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Patents: United States - Patent No: PP 4,939 VIEW USPTO PATENT
rows.Notes: Justice Miniature Roses says this rose has clusters of bright pink blooms from early Spring until the first hard frost. It is a classic example of the pot-forcing varieties so popular in Europe. On their side of the pond, it is called Teeny Weeny...
